audience: small businesses that manage inventory, orders and suppliers in Megaventory

useCases.title: Check stock levels by inventory location
useCases.text: The AI reads physical stock, on hand, on hold, not yet shipped and not yet received per product and location, with the alert level.

useCases.title: Review sales orders and quotes by status
useCases.text: The AI lists sales orders and sales quotes with client, totals, status and rows, filtered by number or status. You see what is still pending.

useCases.title: Review purchase orders to your suppliers
useCases.text: The AI lists purchase orders with supplier, totals, status and the quantity received and invoiced per row, filtered by number, status or supplier.

useCases.title: Review product materials, supplier prices, bundles
useCases.text: The AI reads the bill of materials of a manufactured product, the purchase price of each supplier and the bundles that include the product.

useCases.title: Check work orders in production
useCases.text: The AI lists work orders with finished product, quantity, location, status, priority and the materials allocated.

useCases.title: Add a client or supplier, or draft an order
useCases.text: The AI creates a new client or supplier, or a sales or purchase order in pending status. A pending order is a draft: nothing is shipped, invoiced or paid.
